subject: [hw] T01 differential: k_u8_sad/k_i8_loop failures use vld1 lane/vbit/vmovn; vldst isolated passes
body:
Current run_diff: arm-O0 2340/2340 PASS; arm-O2 vector-only failures. V20-shape suspects, seed 0:
  k_u8_sad   expected 9e378199 got 9e378193 (20/20 arm-O2, 7/20 arm-O3v; small low-bit differences)
  k_i8_loop  expected e89cec75 got 8adb7bdc (20/20)
The k_u8_sad arm-O2 disassembly uses vld1.32 {d18[0]},[r1:32] / {d19[0]},[r2:32], vmovl.u8, vcgt.u16, vbit, vmovl.s16, vsubl.u16, vadd.i32. k_i8_loop uses vld1.64/vstmia/vmovn.i32/i16/vadd.i8/vmin/vmax. My isolated k_neon_vldst passes (plain vld1.64/vst1), and k_neon_vmovn passes, so lane loads or vbit/vcgt combination are the likely V20 part. Note the same k_u8_sad also fails 20/20 at thumb-O2/O3v and 15/20 at thumb-O0 (where no NEON is used - that part is V14s LSRS-by-0 bug). Please reproduce with bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/run_diff.sh; the kernels are in tests/emu/kernels/k12_neon.c and k05_vec.c. I can send the full disassembly of either function.
